rationale: Third-party bodily injury (neighbor's child) arising from an unsafe condition (icy walkway) on the policyholder's premises is a textbook liability claim covered under homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping on ice on the policyholder's front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bill reimbursement. Pediatric injury with fracture requires prompt adjuster engagement for investigation and third-party claim management.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: slip and fall on icy walkway resulting in broken wrist
